data.name: Aim Beat Charm
data.detailed_description:
－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

This game was developed as part of new employee training at Byking Inc.

Depending on your PC environment, you may experience some issues or bugs during play.

We ask for your kind understanding should you encounter any such issues.

A keyboard & mouse, or controller setup is required for play.

Thank you again for your understanding.

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

〇Just what is "Aim Beat Charm"?

Imagine you're a rockin' cool guitarist.

You're at a live show and see haters in the crowd. What d'you do? Charm their socks off!

Take the stage in this first-person rock-rhythm shooter!

―Aim, Beat, Charm! Win over your haters, and let them know you ROCK!―

〇Just remember 3 things, hotshot: Search for 'em! Aim at 'em! And play for 'em!

When the show starts, notes will appear in sync with the intense rock music!

Different songs have different beats, so make sure not to fall behind!

Don't miss the haters in the crowd. They pop-up constantly, and are visible by their blue-green aura.

Deal with them before their numbers get out of control, 'cause...

...if you take too long they'll explode!? So not cool.

Successfully charm a hater, and they'll be converted to a fan.

Keep it up and the whole venue will be rockin', with totally rad lighting to match the vibe!

C'mon hotshot, give 'em the best time ever!

〇The venue size changes with the difficulty

A total of 10 tracks!

3 difficulties to choose from!

The venue size increases when playing higher-difficulty songs.

〇Rock it! Totally FANGAGEMENT!

"Fangagement" is a totally cool ability that charms even the most hardened hater.

Try it while jammin' out and watch them totally come around! It's like an ultimate, man.

―Win your fans over, and make your live show a rock 'n' rollin' good one!―
